steps.text: THE NIGHT BEFORE. Oats (50/70 g), skyr (130/175 g), chia (8/10 g), a full teaspoon of cinnamon, a pinch of salt and 60–80 ml water into a jar. Stir properly — chia clumps if you don't.
Grate HALF the apple (75/95 g) in now, skin on, with lemon over it first.
In the morning: the other half (75/95 g) grated or sliced on top. Peanut butter (10/13 g) warmed 10 seconds and spooned over.

why: Half the apple in, half on. The half that soaks overnight disappears into the oats and sweetens the whole jar; the half added in the morning is the only part that still has any bite left in it.
notes: No ruled defects or D0-003 substitutions apply (no oil, no lettuce). This is a self-made overnight prep, not a draw against the Sunday session's own yields table, so batchSource/batchTakeG stay null despite the batch tag (per D0-013, methods.json's tag wins over fd5's).

Two tracks used only to represent the overnight gap: 'night-before' and 'morning' each carry their own clockStart starting at 0, since a single continuous elapsed clock across an 8+ hour fridge rest isn't meaningful. Total active time across both (~4 min) matches the card's own chip.
